title: Pest Control — Seasonal Route Density
content:
###  **The Route Density Problem** 

Pest control is a route business. Ten customers on three adjacent streets are worth more than twenty scattered across a county — every extra mile between stops erodes the margin on the job. 

###  **Why Timing Changes the Outcome** 

Building density in a territory before peak pest season means the calls that come in during the busiest months land on streets your routes already cover, rather than requiring new detours to serve. 

###  **The Compounding Effect** 

A territory built consistently over several months produces route density that a single seasonal push cannot replicate — every new customer added strengthens the case for the next. 

###  **Timing Matters** 

Companies evaluating territory presence ahead of their peak season are in the strongest position to benefit from it.
